name: Capacitive soil moisture sensor (v1.2)
description: Corrosion-free soil probe with an analog output that FALLS as the soil gets wetter: about 2.9 V in dry air, about 1.2 V in water (analogRead ≈ 590 dry, ≈ 255 wet on a 5 V Uno). VCC to 3.3 V or 5 V, GND to GND, AOUT to an analog pin. Calibrate dry and wet readings for your soil.

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 3.3 to 5.5 V (an on-board 3.3 V regulator feeds the 555 oscillator).

pins.label: AOUT
pins.description: Analog output: higher = drier. To an analog pin (A0).

props.label: Soil moisture
props.description: 0 = probe in dry air, 100 = probe in water. Typical potted soil: 20 % dry, 50 % just watered.

footprint: 98 × 23 mm probe board, 3-pin JST PH 2.0 / 0.1 in header (GND VCC AOUT)

bindings.description: Soil moisture the probe sits in (%).
VCC is high enough for the oscillator.

mechanical.source: typical v1.2 probe; only the electronics end goes in a case

sourcing.generic: Capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 (TLC555), analog out
